scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build --config apps/web/vite.config.ts
scripts.lint: eslint apps/web/src tests/frontend && uv run --frozen ruff check packages apps/api apps/worker tests/contracts
scripts.contracts:generate: uv run --frozen python -m packages.domain_contracts.export && openapi-typescript contracts/openapi.json -o apps/web/src/api/generated.ts
scripts.contracts:check: uv run --frozen python -m packages.domain_contracts.export --check && node scripts/check-client.mjs
